name: Massie Gap day-use lot (trailhead for the Highlands boulders)
basis: A trail guide says the Highlands Bouldering Area is reached by a hike from Massie Gap; Massie Gap has day-hiker lots at the end of the park road. Matched to this unnamed mapped lot by position (about 0.75 km from the area coordinate); the neighbouring w485524829 is the same Massie Gap cluster.
